description: This script provides an API for interacting with the Xbox REST API, including functions for managing packages, processes, device info, and network credentials, as well as a command-line interface for testing and inspection.

classes.name: Xb1NetworkApi
classes.description: A class providing an interface for communicating with a remote Xbox device, including methods for retrieving device info, managing packages, processes, and network credentials, and executing binaries.

methods.name: GetFilesRecursively
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping directory names to lists of file paths, recursively collecting files from a given path.

methods.name: _PrintAndRaiseIfError
methods.description: Prints detailed error information and raises an HTTPError if the response status is not OK.

methods.name: InteractiveCommandLineMode
methods.description: Provides an interactive command-line interface for testing and inspecting Xbox device functions via the Xb1NetworkApi class.
